title: Duel Decks: Elspeth vs. Kiora: card flavor text

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A speaker quoted on Celestial Flare about defeating aggressors.

entities.name: Boros
entities.description: A faction said to fight for justice.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: A faction said to fight for law.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: A city whose people are ruled by Queen Cymede and King Anax.

entities.name: Cymede
entities.description: Queen of Akros who urges her people to learn from leonin adversaries.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A god who gave mortals favor in war at times and withheld aid at others.

entities.name: Polyxene the Doubter
entities.description: A doubter who questions whether mortals are game pieces to Heliod.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who has found loyal friends among loxodons on many planes and recalls the Angel Line of Bant.

entities.name: Brezard Skeinbow
entities.description: Captain of the guard who scoffs at the idea of the southern fortress falling.

entities.name: Anax
entities.description: King of Akros.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A world whose sentries were called the Angel Line.

entities.name: Angel Line
entities.description: The name for Bant's sentries, who never faltered and were ready to die defending their position.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: A Samite inquisitor who speaks on the terrible power of justice.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: A speaker advising learning from both past failures and triumphs.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A world whose fable tells of a leviathan swallowing the seventh sea.

entities.name: Naimah
entities.description: A Femeref philosopher.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: The embodiment of the sea and empress of the depths, whom some believe Kiora to be.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker who explores new oceans and embraces sea-dwellers as her own; some followers believe she is Thassa.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: A place of vegetation that grows faster than it burns.

entities.name: Yon Basrel
entities.description: An Oran-Rief survivalist.

entities.name: Oran-Rief
entities.description: A place from which survivalist Yon Basrel hails.

entities.name: Vorel of the Hull Clade
entities.description: A member of the Hull Clade who seeks faster results than nature.

entities.name: Hull Clade
entities.description: A group to which Vorel belongs.

entities.name: Ranalus
entities.description: A vedalken heretic who found enlightenment in the coatl's scales rather than etherium.

entities.name: Simic
entities.description: A faction that breeds krasis experiments and releases them into new habitats.

entities.name: Momir Vig
entities.description: A speaker who boasts of breeding out a species' shortcomings.

entities.name: etherium
entities.description: A substance in which Ranalus never found enlightenment.

relations.quote: Bant sentries were called the Angel Line.

relations.note: a follower believes Kiora is Thassa
relations.quote: She may call herself Kiora but I believe she is Thassa, the embodiment of the sea and empress of the depths.
